第1603章 歪打正着（第1页）
歪打正着（歪打正着（第22页）以后白泉岛还会拿出一批珍贵的资源，交给龙族贩卖。
黑渊明在白泉岛上秘密停留了三天，两人谈拢了很多具体的合作事项。
期间还把敖甲喊过来，让他们同族见面叙旧。
三天后，白泉岛外的天空中，二狗子送别黑渊明。
“黑兄远道而来，给你包了点土特产。”
二狗子拿出一只鼓鼓囊囊的储物袋，交给黑渊明。
黑渊明接过储物袋，神识往里面扫了一眼，当时就惊呆了。
储物袋里面塞得满满当当，其中有一半，是他那天在大厅中吃的那种仙桃和仙枣。
当时以为张二狗只是随口一说，没想到他真的送了，还送了这么多。
除了仙桃仙枣，另外还有好几种仙果，一石带有一缕仙气的灵谷。
其中竟然还有几十颗金葵籽，散发出诱人的仙气。
另外还有好几瓶丹药，一看就品质不凡。
这些物资，对于如今贫困潦倒的龙族而言，已经是一份重礼了。
他在来之前，就听老祖说起过，张二狗此人贪财小气，往往为了钱财，连命都不要。
说法各不同，有人说他仗义，是一位仁厚的君子。
也有人说他抠门吝啬，坑蒙拐骗，外表忠厚，实则狡诈。
看来传言有误，张二狗还是一位仗义疏财的老实厚道之人。

黑渊明接过储物袋，又行了一礼，带着几分感怀，飞离了白泉岛。
目光偶尔落在黑渊明腰间那鼓鼓囊囊的储物袋上，还有几分不舍。
其实，他拿出这些物资送人，心里还是挣扎了很久，挺肉痛的。
想起朱螭前辈曾经帮过自己不少的忙，就连自己修炼的真龙百变功法，都是朱螭前辈所创。
他心里才好受一些，变得大方不少。
接下来的一段时间，他大部分时间都在修炼。
另外，他还炼制了一批丹药，交给牛大力和敖甲，陈胖子等人。
让他们加紧修炼，300年后随自己一起去参加万妖大会。
二狗子修炼《万灵归宗》，对于资源能量的消耗很大，也很快。
混元岛那边的事务，还有整个混乱之地的管理，都委托给了玉掌柜和另外那两位岛主。
这期间，混乱之地又向两大仙君府供奉了好几次。
包括十年一大贡，每次都会让整个混乱之地伤筋动骨，劳民伤财。
不过，二狗子也得到一则意外的好消息。
因为他把玄阴功大规模派发出去，混乱之地有很多人修炼了。
毕竟这可是玄级功法，修炼之后，实力大幅提升。
修炼玄阴功的修士，本来就是为了机会可以铤而走险的人。
所以在岛上招募炼虚境炮灰时，就有很多修炼玄阴功的炼虚修士报名了。
这些人实力远远高于普通的炮灰，在战场上的生还概率更大。
现在白泉岛派出去的炼虚境炮灰，每1000个人里面，就有十几个人能活着回来。
对于二狗子而言，大规模派发玄阴功，算是歪打正着了。

二狗子没有食言，把这些人全都收进了圣贤书院，免费提供资源，培养到合体期。

Chapter 1603: A mistake (Page 1)
In the future, Baiquan Island will also come up with a batch of precious resources and hand them over to the Dragon Clan for sale.
Kuro Yuanming stayed secretly on Baiquan Island for three days, and the two discussed many specific cooperation matters.
During this period, he also called Ao Jia over and asked them to meet and reminisce about the past.
Three days later, in the sky outside Baiquan Island, Ergouzi bid farewell to Hei Yuanming.
"Brother Hei came all the way to bring you some local specialties."
Ergouzi took out a bulging storage bag and handed it to Hei Yuanming.
Hei Yuanming took the storage bag, glanced inside with his consciousness, and was stunned.
The storage bag was stuffed to the brim, half of which was the peaches and dates he ate in the hall that day.
At that time, I thought Zhang Ergou was just saying it casually, but I didn't expect that he actually gave it away, and even gave it so much.
In addition to the fairy peaches and fairy dates, there are also several kinds of fairy fruits, and there is a spiritual valley with a ray of fairy energy in every stone.
There are actually dozens of golden sunflower seeds among them, exuding an alluring fairy aura.
There are also several bottles of elixirs, which are of extraordinary quality at first glance.
These supplies are already a great gift to the now impoverished Dragon Clan.
Before he came, he had heard from his ancestor that Zhang Ergou was greedy and stingy, and would often risk his life for money.
There are different opinions. Some people say that he is just and a kind gentleman.
Some people also say that he is stingy, cheating, and honest on the outside, but in fact he is cunning.
It seems that the rumors are wrong, Zhang Ergou is still an honest and kind person who is generous with his wealth.
Hei Yuanming took the storage bag, bowed again, and flew away from Baiquan Island with some gratitude.
Occasionally, his eyes fell on the bulging storage bag on Hei Yuanming's waist, still a little reluctant to let go.
In fact, when he took out these supplies to give away, he still struggled for a long time and it was quite heartbreaking.
I remembered that Senior Zhu Chi had helped me a lot. Even the True Dragon Hundred Changes technique that I practiced was created by Senior Zhu Chi.
He felt better and became more generous.
In the next period of time, he spent most of his time practicing.
In addition, he also refined a batch of elixirs and gave them to Niu Dali, Ao Jia, Fatty Chen and others.
Let them step up their practice and join him in the Ten Thousand Demons Conference 300 years later.
Ergouzi's practice of "All Souls Return to the Clan" consumes a lot of resources and energy very quickly.
The affairs of Hunyuan Island, as well as the management of the entire chaotic land, were entrusted to Shopkeeper Yu and the other two island owners.
During this period, the Chaos Land offered sacrifices to the two Immortal Lords' Mansion several times.
Including a large tribute every ten years, every time it will strain the entire chaotic land and waste people and money.
However, Er Gouzi also got an unexpected piece of good news.
Because he distributed Xuanyin Kung on a large scale, many people practiced it in the chaotic land.
After all, this is a Xuan-level skill. After practicing it, your strength will be greatly improved.
Monks who practice Xuanyin Kung are people who are willing to take risks for opportunities.
Therefore, when recruiting cannon fodder in the Void Refining Realm on the island, many Void Refining monks who practice Xuanyin Kung signed up.
These people are much stronger than ordinary cannon fodder, and have a greater chance of survival on the battlefield.
Currently, among the cannon fodder sent out by Baiquan Island, more than a dozen people out of every 1,000 can come back alive.
For Er Gouzi, distributing Xuanyin Kung on a large scale was a mistake.
Ergouzi did not break his promise and took all these people into the Sage Academy, providing free resources and training them to the integration stage.
